claim: Erik Marcisak was named one of Top Ten "Comedy Best Bets" by a brand with special focus on casting, job opportunities, and career advice.
evidencia:
Page: Erik Marcisak. Sentence: Erik Marcisak was named one of "Backstage"'s Top Ten "Comedy Best Bets" in 2005 for producing the controversial sketch comedy show "Saturday Night Rewritten", which used the previous night's "Saturday Night Live" as a creative jumping-off point for an entirely new sketch show that was written, rehearsed, and performed within 8 hours the next day.
Page: Backstage (magazine). Sentence: Backstage (aka Back Stage) is an entertainment-industry brand aimed at people working in film and the performing arts, with a special focus on casting, job opportunities, and career advice.
